description: A board of columns with cards people move between them: an order pipeline, support tickets, tasks. Each card is your own markup. Cards move by a Move menu on each card, by picking one up and placing it with the arrow keys or a tap, or by dragging with a mouse, a pen or a finger held on the card; every move is read out to screen readers and can be undone, and the card rings for a moment where it lands. A move fires kanban:move, and with move-url is sent to your app, which keeps it or sends it back with a reason, the card ringing red. Readonly boards and columns, locked cards, and a button per column when they don't fit side by side, as on a phone. Works inside Livewire components, with wire:kanban-move.

consider.note: The move arrives as JSON from the browser: validate `card` and `to` (`exists:`, `Rule::in()`), authorize the card, and enforce which moves are allowed on the server, from the order's current stage, not by which columns the board shows.
Shifting every card below on each drop is one big update per move. Consider sort values with gaps (1000, 2000, …), so a move usually updates only the card, and renumbering happens rarely.
